stemMd: The forelimbs of a whale and a bat have corresponding bones inherited from a common ancestor but different functions. They are best described as what?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Structures produced only by individual exercise

options.label: C
options.textMd: Evidence that the two animals are the same species

options.label: D
options.textMd: Identical adaptations with no ancestry relationship

explanationMd: Homology is similarity due to shared ancestry, even when function differs. Analogy concerns similar function arising independently, so function alone is not the criterion here.

distractorRationale.d: The stem explicitly provides shared ancestry.
